symptom: After the mdl 1 pass of the skills (PR #900), with `TestSkillsTeachMDL1` green, xpath-constraints still taught `$Next = $Game/MoveSeq + 1; retrieve $M … limit 1;` and `$Cutoff = addDays(…)` (mdl 1 refuses the bare reassignment, and `limit 1` there is a list, not the object), and two one-statement scripts (an `alter entity … add event handler`, a `sql … generate connector` sequence) had no `mdl 1;` header
cause: `conformance.MarkdownUnits` only recognised a fence that opens at the start of a line; a fence inside a blockquote (`> ```mdl`, the example in a callout) was not a unit for either gate, so its MDL was never parsed or judged
insight: A green no-allowlist gate proves only what its extractor reads. Callouts are where the most pointed examples live ("compute it first, like this"), and they were exactly the blocks no gate saw. Reading blockquoted fences added no canonical-form findings and four mdl 1 ones; a cheap cross-check is to grep the docs for fences the extractor skipped (`^\s*>\s*````) and compare counts
